analogy.rationale: Antithyroid agents inhibit thyroid peroxidase (TPO), an enzyme not expressed in these cell lines, so they should produce little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other nuclear-receptor or hormone-related classes that also act on pathways minimally active in these cells.
